fact: Nessma TV reports the Ministry of Employment launched the national register of community companies, a digital platform for creating and following them, accessible from that day at alahlia.tn.
The Registre National des Entreprises says it is moving to full digitalisation, with all procedures online only from 1 July 2026 and no more physical filing at counters.
The Registre National des Entreprises says its electronic safe account for each registered firm is tied to the firm's unique identifier, the matricule fiscal.

The National Business Register's Director General announced that from 1 July 2026 paper file submissions end in favour of fully digital procedures via its electronic platform, with online tax-ID issuance to follow by end September 2026.

A ministerial council on 15 August 2026 reviewed projects completed in the first half of 2026, including the complete digitisation of transactions between the Registre national des entreprises and economic operators.

The U.S. Embassy's USAID project page lists among achievements that it developed and launched the RNE (National Business Register) website portal and created an online registration platform for businesses.

The Registre National des Entreprises, in service since 5 February 2019, completed full digitisation in July 2026, so filing, registration and updates can all be done remotely on its digital platform, says its director general Adel Chaouari.
The Registre National des Entreprises also manages the register of beneficial owners, set up for anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing purposes, according to the article.

La Presse reports the Registre national des entreprises platform lets project owners register a company remotely, including choosing the trade name, and that the RNE has run a mixed electronic and paper filing system since September 2025.

The Presidency of the Government decree of 13 January 2026 says the Centre national du registre des entreprises makes beneficial-owner information on legal persons and arrangements available in real time to competent authorities and via its digital platform to obliged entities and, on legitimate interest, the public.

L'Economiste Maghrebin reports RNE director general Adel Chouari saying the RNE has digitised company creation (individuals, SARL, SA) and online filing of financial statements, which more than 65,000 firms use.
The article says the RNE assigns the unique identifier required for all administrative and tax procedures, under law 2018-52 of 29 October 2018.

RNE Director General Adel Chouari said some National Business Register services are fully digitised, others experimental or in final phase, and incorporation is being digitised starting with individuals, with 90% of services online targeted by mid-2025.

Thomas Denfer, president of the Alliance francophone des registres du commerce, says Tunisia's RNE is digitising and making accessible its historical company records, with a digitisation drive over the last ten years accelerating recently.
